purpose: Verify eleven AP tables, six permissions and their system-admin grants, receipt and return references, invoice, payment, credit and refund constraints, immutable audit records, and the AP Business Master impact checker.
data: Three cases on the ordinary migrated MySQL fixture. One reads schema and grants. The second inserts bounded synthetic invoice, payment, reservation and audit rows in a rolled-back transaction. The third inserts up to four valid credits, two refunds, one credit line and one credit application, plus document sequences and audit samples. Constraint probes disable foreign keys only on their own connection, then roll back.
thresholds: All three cases pass. Exact schema, authorization, balances, constraint, numbering, audit and checker assertions. Existing coverage floors remain in place.
trigger: Existing ci.yml functional server MySQL shards for admitted PRs and main. Same discovery, workers, jobs and schedule.
cost: Three serial cases in the existing shard. The three took 0.13–0.14 seconds together on upgraded isolated local databases. CI time has not been measured.

cases: AP installs exactly eleven tables and grants the six permissions only to system-admin
AP balances, invoice reservations, and audit immutability survive direct SQL writes
AP credit and refund tables enforce amounts and accept their sequence and audit types
